ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Amazon SSM Agent Hijacking
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential Amazon SSM agent hijack attempts as outlined in the Mitiga research report.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\amazon\\-ssm\\-agent\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-register\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-code\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-id\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-region\\ .*")))
